messages:
julia-cs: customer reported that after last night's model rollout their product pages started showing stray characters before code snippets. they say it breaks our markdown rendering in their UI. attaching quick repro they shared.

julia-cs: repro curl they used: 
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-v2-medium","prompt":"Show a python example to open a file","max_tokens":120}'
```

julia-cs: their reported response (trimmed):
```
>>> ```python
>>> with open('data.csv') as f:
>>>     print(f.readline())
>>> ```
```

julia-cs: note the extra leading >>> tokens before each fence/backtick line. their markdown renderer treats those as text so the snippet is not recognized.

irene-support: ack. which rollout did we push last night? @deploy-bot any annotations? :eyes: 

deploy-bot: rollout completed: redwood-runtime v2.1.4 -> deployed 2026-03-16T21:00:12Z to hosted-prod. Model catalog updated: redwood-v2-medium (weights: q4_0). Canary complete.

sam-ml: do we have any tokenization changes or stop-sequence adjustments in v2.1.4 that could inject prefixes? not aware of intentional behavior like that.

nate-eng: nothing in serving runtime should prepend text. could be a small postprocessing filter for markdown normalization that misfires with quantized kernels. assigning myself to repro.

julia-cs: customer says it only started after ~21:15 UTC. they also said turning on stop_sequences ["\n\n"] didn't fully prevent it. they tried pinning to redwood-v2-medium@2026-01-12 and issue went away.

sam-ml: good repro note. can you paste a full request/response (raw) or a curl with -v? need to confirm it's model output not client-side change.

julia-cs: pasted their raw capture (sanitized):
```json
{"request": {"model": "redwood-v2-medium", "input": "Show a python example to open a file"}, "response": "\n>>> ```python\n>>> with open('data.csv') as f:\n>>>     print(f.readline())\n>>> ```\n"}
```

julia-cs: customer also tried embedding the code in triple backticks in the prompt and got duplication: two sets of backticks, one with >>>.

sam-ml: sounds like a regression in post-gen markdown-normalizer. @nate-eng can you confirm whether the pipeline that escapes or sanitizes candidate completions was changed in the last PR? check commit diffs around markdown_* files.

nate-eng: scanning diffs now. saw one change: a patch intended to treat leading '>' quote-lines as blockquotes was extended to aggressively prefix lines when detection confidence was low. probable bug: it erroneously applies to triple-backtick fences. PR 4821.

irene-support: any quick mitigation we can tell the customer? pinning model helped but they want a production-safe workaround.

sam-ml: short-term: set response_filtering = false for the route (if enabled) or disable 'markdown_normalizer' flag in console for that model-route. also post-process strip leading '>>> ' or patterns '^>>>\s' on lines before rendering.

julia-cs: told customer the pin workaround works and suggested postprocessing regex. they asked if we can hotfix on our side.

nate-eng: I can revert the aggressive patch and push a canary hotfix to hosted-prod within the hour. will run unit tests for other quote/blockquote cases.

sam-ml: please also add an integration test reproducing the triple-backtick case so we don't regress again.

julia-cs: customer replied: "thanks, that would be great — we're holding a release on our side until this is fixed."

nate-eng: deploying rollback canary to 10% traffic now. monitor channel eng-releases for perf regressions.

deploy-bot: deploy started: revert PR 4821 -> canary 10% at 2026-03-17T01:12:03Z.

irene-support: customer updated: they no longer see the >>> prefix after pinning and we gave them the postprocess regex as a stopgap. :relieved:

sam-ml: logging follow-up task: add a fuzzy guard in markdown_normalizer so it never prefixes fence/backtick lines, and add unit tests around triple-backticks and fenced code with language tags. ticket -> ENG-9012.

julia-cs: thx team. will keep customer in loop and confirm once full rollback is live.

nate-eng: final note: root cause = overzealous blockquote heuristic from PR 4821 interacting with quantized model outputs that sometimes split fence tokens across chunks. fix implemented to ensure we check for exact fence tokens before prefixing.
